requires: consensus with recommendation proceed_to_implementation and no unresolved disposition
exact human architecture and scope ratification bound to consensus and paused intake state
all CPU/no-model schema, semantic, golden-vector, replay, visibility, reducer, power, and run-lock-schema fixtures pass
stages.scope: ratified CPU/no-model implementation and fixtures only

requires: T01 through T13 passing at their declared stage
two independently implemented static seal receipts
author-side advocate receipt that cannot override review
separate exact human run ratification bound to run_lock, seals, review, advocate, and predecessor
stages.scope: exact run authorized by separate human decision

requires: allowlisted dispatch preflight for every dispatch
registered runtime perturbation and integrity receipts
recomputed contrasts, assay composites, Holm, missingness, blockers, and literal claim releases

receipt_rule: Every stage receipt contains artifact_type, stage, exact subject hashes, predecessor receipt hash, scope, decision owner, decision evidence path/hash/excerpt where human, passed, and model_execution_reachable. It validates against the stage-specific schema and recomputes all requires. No stage may be skipped or self-asserted.
preflight_rule: Every dispatch class calls one allowlisted preflight with dispatch class, executable hash, run_lock hash, PRE_MODEL_EXECUTION receipt hash, and immediate predecessor state. The preflight permits only if the receipt recomputes as passing, reachable=true, dispatch is allowlisted by the exact run lock, and hashes match; otherwise no process is started and a denial receipt is written.
